summary.text: Tracey Breazeale is the Democratic candidate for Minnesota House of Representatives District 45A in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican incumbent Andrew Myers.
A business executive, she also ran for the seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Tracey Breazeale earned a bachelor's degree from Brown University in 1988 and a graduate degree from Harvard Business School in 1993.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she was born in Minnesota, has lived in the Lake Minnetonka area with her husband and four children for 25 years, and spent decades in finance, strategy and business leadership.
She also said she has served two terms on a city council and sits on the boards of local nonprofits, including Minneapolis Crisis Nursery and Jeremiah Program.
Breazeale was the Democratic nominee for District 45A in 2024, when Andrew Myers defeated her 55.0 percent to 44.9 percent.

In her 2026 survey responses she listed fiscal responsibility, including audits to stop fraud and waste and tax reform that would stop taxing Social Security, along with a "people over politics" theme that includes gun violence prevention legislation.
